about.title: About Dr. Fadili
about.subtitle: Excellence in medicine, a human approach
about.paragraph1: Dr. Fadili Lamiaa is a specialist in gynecology-obstetrics and aesthetic medicine, driven by a deep passion for women's health and natural beauty.
about.paragraph2: With over 15 years of experience, she combines rigorous medical expertise with artistic sensitivity to offer each patient unique, gentle, and tailored care.
about.paragraph3: Her practice is a space of trust where every woman is welcomed with respect, attentiveness, and kindness.
credentials: Doctor of Medicine — Faculty of Medicine, Casablanca
Member of the Moroccan Society of Gynecology
